agent_notes: Normal TLS verification was attempted first. Public GET requests then used curl --insecure only after the managed proxy returned the exact self signed certificate in chain error.

Google and Bing command-line discovery responses were not used as evidence because Google returned CAPTCHA pages and Bing did not provide a reliable official result; the official domain was independently confirmed by direct HTTPS GET.

The 2026-27 University Campus Information Brochure and official Programmes Offered, Regular Courses and Self-Finance Courses pages were used as the catalogue. Entries explicitly marked Suspended in the official brochure were excluded. Short-term events and syllabus-only subject papers were excluded.

Some career-tree disciplines such as Geography, Yoga, Library and Information Science, Sanskrit, Urdu, Home Science and Pharmacy do not have exact nodes; those courses use clearly labelled nearest-parent or closest-specialization mappings with reduced confidence.
